# Inference gateway compatibility and deletion matrix runbook

This runbook is the P-004 release contract for migrating legacy gateway capacity fields to the capless resource governor. The machine-readable matrix is exported from packages/operator-core/lib/inference-gateway/capacity-inventory.ts as INFERENCE_GATEWAY_CAPACITY_COMPATIBILITY_MATRIX.

## Contract for every legacy field

1. Observe only: read the legacy value once with source, units, generation, timestamp, and freshness. It may seed desired controller state once; it is never passed as a maximum or recovery ceiling.
2. Warn and read back: report the raw value beside desired, effective, recommendation, applied, queue, and measured physical state. Missing or stale evidence remains unknown; it is never coerced to zero or safe.
3. Focused removal release: run the named plan gate, prove parity with the canonical durable queue/controller, then delete the binding writer or reclassify it as semantic safety or an evidenced external physical contract.
4. Rollback: switch the affected lane to observe-only while preserving durable receipts, queue history, state snapshots, and telemetry. Rollback must never reinstall a numeric productive-capacity ceiling.
5. Consumers: update the exact docs/runbook, API/tool route, and durable state/read-model paths listed in the matrix. Do not infer meaning from a field name alone.

## Field-family matrix

| Family | Observe-only migration | Warning/readback | Removal release | Rollback |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PAPERCUSP_GATEWAY_CONCURRENCY / Claude default | Record env/launch provenance and seed desired state once | Show raw value, boundBy, desired/effective, generation, freshness | P-010/P-012 | Observe-only; no numeric cap restore |
| PAPERCUSP_GATEWAY_CODEX_CONCURRENCY / account scaling | Record override and account-pool observation | Show account evidence and unknown/stale state | P-010 | Observe-only; no numeric cap restore |
| MAX_QUEUED / resident queue | Annotate legacy depth while durable receipts own acceptance | Show durable depth/age and persistence health | P-006/P-014 | Observe-only; preserve receipts |
| Per-account/min-admission | Publish serviceability as attribution, not a formula | Show recommendation versus applied and freshness | P-007 | Observe-only; no synthetic floor |
| AIMD floor/cap/tuning | Record bootstrap settings; controller feedback is scoped and expiring | Show decrease reason, streak, generation, expiry | P-005/P-009 | Observe-only; resume upward probing |
| Priority reserve/map/caps | Keep ordering, aging, and service objectives; idle slots remain borrowable | Show tier, wait age, and borrowed slots | P-008 | Observe-only; preserve fair scheduling |
| Provider floors/global rate gate | Use fresh headers, usage windows, and outcomes; absent headers trigger probes | Show provider/account key, source, age, penalty, expiry | P-009 | Observe-only; no baked floor |
| Operator rate-limit cap/provider bounds | Keep persisted settings as non-binding intent | Warn on present/invalid/stale settings | P-009/P-012 | Observe-only; preserve config history |
| Resource-profile limits | Keep host signals for attribution/bootstrap only | Show profile generation and signal freshness | P-004/P-009/P-012 | Observe-only; profile cannot cap gateway work |
| Local-backend maxConcurrent/parallel slots | Retain only a fresh engine/model/hardware contract | Show backend id, engine evidence, age, and physical/policy classification | P-011 | Observe-only; retain only evidenced physical state |
| Local-backend client cap | Record owner demand and circuit outcomes | Show owner fairness and canonical scheduler decision | P-011 | Observe-only; preserve owner history |
| UI/API/state readbacks | Keep fields but attach writer, unit, term, generation, age, expiry | Preserve unknown/stale verbatim | P-013 | Readback-only; never enforce by display |

## Verification

Run the focused tests:

npm --workspace @papercusp/operator-core test -- lib/inference-gateway/capacity-inventory.test.ts lib/inference-gateway/capacity-compatibility.test.ts

Before a release gate, confirm validateInferenceGatewayCapacityCompatibilityMatrix() returns an empty list and that every matrix row has a docs/runbook, API, state, and test consumer. A row with a missing writer or a rollback contract that permits a numeric cap is a release blocker.

## Governing decisions

D-001: use the canonical admission contract, durable queue/receipts, CaplessAdaptiveController, causal health, leases, snapshots, and lint; do not build a second governor.
D-002: legacy values are bootstrap state, never ceilings.
D-005/D-009: external constraints and every reported capacity number carry live writer, units, source, freshness, and binding term.
D-010: rollback disables enforcement without restoring any numeric cap.
